runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game <driver> --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-empty-dir> --scenario <tools/harness-scenarios/system-11/bk2k-*.json> --boot-wait 0 --ready-timeout 30 --handle-mechanics 0 --output <external-json>, run through the staging wrapper bk2k_run.py. Every state directory is new and empty; the single retained init run (bk2k-nvram-init.json) boots to FACTORY SETTING and its nvram/<driver>.nv is the only file any later run inherits. Each diagnostic scenario then waits 16 s for power-up, sets Manual-Down (-6 = 0), pulses Advance (-7) to enter the tests, sets Auto-Up (-6 = 1) and pulses Advance until the required checkpoint text is displayed.

la2-coil.limitation: Names come from the ROM's own coil table (U27, entries in table order) and are accepted only when the decoded display text of that step equals the table entry exactly (whitespace-normalized); the ROM draws the numeral 1 as 0x0006 and the period in bit 15. A pulsed address is ROM activity, not proof that a load is fitted: entries the ROM names UNUSED still pulse.
la2-coil.note: Auto-Up Advance walk to COIL TEST (test 05) then 3 complete cycles of 30 steps, period 29.752 s, every cycle pulsing the same addresses in the same order. First cycle, step:address=ROM name (display step/side): 1:1=OUTHOLE (01 A SIDE); 2:25=RED BOLT (01 C SIDE); 3:2=BALL SERVE (02 A SIDE); 4:26=BLUE BOLT (02 C SIDE); 5:3=LEFT 3 BANK (03 A SIDE); 6:27=CENTER FLASHER (03 C SIDE); 7:4=RIGHT 3 BANK (04 A SIDE); 8:28=FLIP LANE FLASH (04 C SIDE); 9:5=UNUSED (05 A SIDE); 10:29=MID. DROP FLASHER (05 C SIDE); 11:6=BALL POPPER (06 A SIDE); 12:30=RAMP FLASHER (06 C SIDE); 13:7=LEVEL 3 KICKER (07 A SIDE); 14:31=RIGHT FLASHER (07 C SIDE); 15:8=RIGHT EJECT (08 A SIDE); 16:32=3-LOCK FLASHER (08 C SIDE); 17:9=INSERT G.I. (09); 18:10=LEVEL 2 G.I. (10); 19:11=LEVEL 1 G.I. (11); 20:12=A/C   SELECT (12); 21:13=KICKBACK (13); 22:14=KNOCKER (14); 23:15=MAGNA SAVE (15); 24:16=MOTOR 3 BANK (16); 25:17=LEFT  BUMPER (17); 26:18=LEFT  KICKER (18); 27:19=RIGHT BUMPER (19); 28:20=RIGHT KICKER (20); 29:21=LOWER BUMPER (21); 30:22=UNUSED (22). Public 12 is on for every C-side step (25-32) and off for every A-side step (1-8).

la2-init.note: Boot to FACTORY SETTING from empty NVRAM; the NVRAM written on stop is the only state later runs inherit.

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes and NVRAM remain external.
source.manifest_algorithm: source.sha256 is SHA-256 of manifest.json's exact bytes. manifest.json is compact canonical JSON with sorted keys, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, plus one LF, of {files: [{path, sha256, size}], format: 'pinmame-external-evidence-manifest', game, version: 1}; files lists every file under source.path recursively (the raw run JSON, its command record, its log and every state-directory file) except manifest.json and manifest.sha256, sorted by POSIX relative path. tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py writes and re-checks it.
